title: Sorceress of the Cosmic Storm
description: A powerful sorceress with flowing white hair stands on a storm-battered stone bridge over a turbulent sea, holding a glowing staff topped with a fiery phoenix. She is surrounded by swirling cosmic clouds, golden runes, and a distant ruined city as people flee across the collapsing bridge amid shipwrecks and crashing waves.
prompt: A majestic sorceress with long flowing white hair stands on a crumbling stone bridge over a violent stormy sea, holding a tall ornate staff topped with a glowing orange phoenix. She wears an intricate gold and blue corseted gown with billowing ribbons. Swirling cosmic clouds, stars, moons, and golden runes fill the dramatic sky above a ruined city on the horizon. People are fleeing across the bridge as massive waves crash against shipwrecks below, in an epic fantasy style.
